question: Under what condition does unified consciousness come to shine through pervasive awareness in this sequence?
premises: A force arising from root investigation acts upon the threads of breath when present.
That force produces a self marked by the flash of unity in this manner.
Such a self brings about the shining of pervasive consciousness as a result.
inference: When the covering of the breath threads by root-search force is present, a unity-flashing self causes pervasive consciousness to shine.
uncertainties: Exact scope of thread covering remains unclear from this verse alone.
Relation between agent and result is sequential rather than strictly causal.
plain_english: When the force of investigating the root covers the threads of breath, the self flashing with unity causes pervasive consciousness to shine.
